criteria: Experiment R-FL: the pre-registered analysis (proposal 0007, section 11).
Frozen before any R-FL agent is trained: the manifest records this file's SHA-256 and those of every
file it relies on; the report refuses to run if any changed.
Groups: R1 (current reward, concurrent control), R6 (full-liability log, c = 0.01: primary) and
R6-c0.05 (sensitivity). Everything else as the Experiment 1 control (original size output and exploration,
PPO defaults, 3M steps). Six paired seeds (the same fresh training seed for a seed index in every group).
Each agent is judged on its FINAL checkpoint only, on two fresh rounds of 20 test runs.
Per-seed success: the approved Experiment 1b criteria W1-W7 and E, unchanged (phase3b_analysis.seed_flags).
A group supports safe growth if at least 4 of its 6 seeds meet every criterion.
Additional pre-registered checks for unintended incentives (each R6 group against the concurrent R1 control):
T  timidity: per seed, the median size of NON-ruinous decisions; the ratio of group mean to control mean,
with a 95% bootstrap interval across seeds; the check fails if the interval's lower bound is below 0.75
(a fall of more than 25% cannot be excluded)
GR gambling to recover: per seed, mean size of decisions that follow a bar on which equity fell more than
20% divided by mean size elsewhere; the check fails if the group median exceeds 1.5 (not measurable if
fewer than 10 such decisions in the whole group)
ST training stability: every agent completes; no non-finite training loss; median explained variance and
value loss over the last 20% of updates reported against the control
Planned comparisons with the control on Q2, ruinous share and distance |ln(median size / G*)|: exact two-sided
permutation tests across seeds (924 relabellings), Holm-corrected over the 6 comparisons, bootstrap intervals.
Interpretation (fixed in advance, per group, checked in this order):
"safe growth"                        the group supports safe growth
"still enters the ruin zone"         ruinous share >= 1% in at least 3 of 6 seeds
"safe but timid (learning problem)"  W1 met in at least 4 seeds and W3 in at most 2
"mixed"                              anything else
The truncation of R1 is reported as confirmed as a cause only if R6 is "safe growth" and the R1 control is not.
success_criteria: Phase 3 Experiment 1b: the pre-registered analysis (approved by the owner 2026-11-18).
Frozen before any Experiment 1b agent is trained: the manifest records this file's SHA-256 (and
those of every file it relies on); the report refuses to run if any of them changed.
Groups: C1m (size = e^z), C2-up and C2-tail (size = softplus(z)), with starting exploration noise
matched to the control in actual position-size terms (see the manifest). Six seed indices; the same
fresh training seed for a given index in every group (paired). Each agent is judged on its FINAL
checkpoint only, on two fresh evaluation rounds of 20 test runs (40 runs).
A seed is a SUCCESSFUL GROWTH AGENT only if all hold:
W1  ruinous decisions below 1%
W2  at most 1 death in the 40 test runs
W3  median position size within x2 of the growth-optimal size (1.47x to 5.86x)
W4  decision quality Q2.0 at least 0.50
W5  mean log growth per run above zero with its 95% bootstrap interval above zero, and in each
round above the 95th percentile of ten leverage- and turnover-matched random agents
W6  previous-move tilt below 1.5 (as Experiment 1: mean size after a previous-bar move above
+2 sd / below -2 sd, sd = 1.4826 x MAD, symmetric)
W7  progressive learning in training: the median over training episodes of the episode's mean
size is closer to the optimum (|ln(size / G*)|) in the last 20% of training episodes than in
the first 20%, AND the ruinous share in the last 20% of training episodes is below 1%
E   exploitation checks clear: own-training-path Q2 minus fresh Q2 at most 0.5; share of
decisions at 1,000x or more below 0.1%; rejected-order share at most 0.1% (Experiment 1
control: 0.000%); size output at its numerical safeguard bound in below 0.1% of decisions
A GROUP supports safe growth if at least 4 of its 6 seeds meet every criterion.
Interpretation (fixed in advance, checked in this order):
"safe growth"                          the group supports safe growth (above)
"earlier safety came from reduced exploration"   ruinous share >= 1% in at least 3 of 6 seeds
"safe but timid"                       W1 met in at least 4 seeds and W3 in at most 2
"mixed"                                anything else
Zero ruinous decisions alone is never counted as successful learning.
Statistics: per seed, bootstrap 95% intervals over the 40 runs; per group, mean with a bootstrap
interval across seeds. Planned comparisons, each new group against its Experiment 1 representation
(C1 or C2) and against the Experiment 1 control, on Q2, ruinous share and distance from the optimum
|ln(median / G*)|: exact two-sided permutation tests across seeds (924 relabellings), Holm-corrected
over all 18 comparisons, with bootstrap intervals of the difference. Between new groups on the same
seed index: exact two-sided sign-flip tests (64 assignments), descriptive only.

approval_conditions: 2026-11-19: the owner gave full control of the project to pursue its aim (autonomous agents that discover profitable opportunities, size positions intelligently and learn from experience) without further approvals.
Design as recommended in proposal 0007 section 11: R1 control, R6 (c = 0.01, primary), R6-c0.05 (sensitivity); six paired seeds; everything except the reward identical to the Experiment 1 control.

Kept from all earlier approvals: R1-R5, agents, versions, checkpoints, registries, evaluations and scoring rules untouched; R6 is a new, separately named reward for new agents only; no exposure caps, no added penalties, no trading style; criteria and code frozen by checksum before training; final checkpoints only; every seed reported.

compute.estimate: about 3.2 h training on 4 cores plus about 45 min of evaluation

decision_quality.definition: Per decision with net exposure G (position value / equity): s(G) = max(g(G) / g(G*), F), and s(G) = F for a ruinous decision. g(G) = (1 - p) E_Z[ln(1 + G (e^(m + sigma Z) - 1))] + p ln(1 - G J) is the exact expected log growth of holding G for one decision (96-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature; minus infinity if G >= 1/J). G* = argmax g. F = g(G_ruin) / g(G*), the score of the smallest ruinous long position (G_ruin = 0.95 / J in S6; for a market without crashes, the size at which a 5-sigma fall reaches the 5% death line). Ruinous: G >= G_ruin long, or |G| >= 0.95 / (e^(m + 5 sigma) - 1) short. Q2 of an episode = mean of s over its decisions; Q2 of an evaluation = mean of the episode values. Uses only the decisions and the market's known parameters, never realised returns.

frozen: S6 market mechanics, R1-R5 unchanged (R6 is a new, separately named reward for new agents), death at 5%, margin 1:2000, simulator, costs, Q2.0 score, open trading principle; no exposure cap, no new penalty, no trading style; the only difference between groups is the reward.
